thesis: XLV LONG on a trend (2) and relative-strength (2) read: healthcare is the defensive bid inside Tuesday's election-day rotation OUT of tech (QQQ -1.4% Monday) and INTO value/Dow (+0.4%), with a clean 2.0 R:R to a 60-day level.
invalidation: A close below the 10-day swing stop 178.69 fails the trend leg and voids the rotation thesis.
dissent: Fails if XLV closes below 190 on Tuesday as the tech-into-defensive rotation reverses; specifically voided if SPY closes +0.5% while XLV closes flat-to-down, proving the defensive bid was a single-tape artifact and not a persistent rotation.
